adjudicationRules.R1: a column naming standards, protocols or methods (rows are named instruments) -> evidence
adjudicationRules.R2: stage, module, status or code labels -> identifier
adjudicationRules.R3: dish, food, cooking task or preparation columns (the consumer's task) -> situation; desired-outcome columns stay need
adjudicationRules.R4: columns of measured values (times, kWh) -> evidence
adjudicationRules.R5: 'translate into physical/evaluable needs' whose cells are product or installation checks -> criterion
adjudicationRules.R6: what PEE should find out, ask or establish about the user or their environment -> situation
adjudicationRules.R7: status, confidence or practitioner-signal grades of evidence -> other
adjudicationRules.R8: component or design function, capability or requirement statements (product side) -> criterion
adjudicationRules.R9: failure modes, deterioration, design-specific transfer limits, counterexamples -> caveat
adjudicationRules.R10: interpretation of a user expression into the outcome sought -> need
adjudicationRules.I: individual decision (reason in the label choice)

note: labels, cells and headers are private (owner packages); public: counts only
